resources.string: Commands
When the agent wants to run a command
Run it
Commands run right away. You won\'t be asked.
Ask me first
You see each command and choose to allow or reject it.
Commands work differently on a phone
On a computer the harness can run commands in a sandbox. Android doesn\'t allow one, so here a command can change anything in the harness\'s own storage.
Still protected
The harness stays inside this app. It can\'t see your photos, contacts, messages or other apps.
Not protected
It can use the internet, and a command could delete your workspace or the harness\'s settings and saved API keys.
You can change this later on the harness page, and switch any chat from its permission button.
Got it
Restart the harness?
Your choice applies to chats you start after a restart. Chats you already have keep their setting, and you can switch one from its permission button.
Restart now
Later
The harness is still running with “%1$s”. Restart it so new chats use your choice.
This harness version can\'t ask before commands. Update it to choose whether commands run right away or ask you first.
Ask before commands
Asks you before each command and before changes outside the workspace.
Runs commands and changes files without asking.
